toegepas.voor: By latere gemeenskappe en vandag nog is twee soorte tradisionele genesers bekend.
toegepas.na: By latere gemeenskappe was twee soorte tradisionele genesers bekend, en dit is vandag nog so.
toegepas.rede_vinder: One present-tense verb is stretched over a past phrase (later communities) and a present one (today); splitting the tenses reads naturally and keeps 'bekend', 'tradisionele genesers' and the meaning.
toegepas.fout: One present-tense 'is' is stretched over a past setting (later communities) and the present (today), which reads awkwardly.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The split tenses read naturally, keep 'tradisionele genesers', 'bekend' and the later-communities-and-today meaning intact, and the comma before 'en' joins two full clauses as the AWS requires.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'vandag nog steeds' doubles up; 'vandag nog' already says it still happens today.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'vandag nog steeds' is ordinary, natural emphatic Afrikaans, so trimming 'steeds' is a lateral move.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: The protected entry is 'nyanga', but the lesson writes 'inyanga' throughout, including the glossary headword, so the whole-word protection never matches anything in this lesson; a person should check whether the entry should read 'inyanga' (or both) so the guard actually protects it.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: bokke en hase gejag vir die vleis
laat_vaar_vorige.na: bokke en hase vir die vleis gejag
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Afrikaans puts the past participle after the adverbial phrase; the extraposed 'gejag vir die vleis' follows English order.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Extraposing the paired 'vir die vleis en ook vir die velle' phrase is natural; the proposal splits that parallel and reads worse.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Net soos ons het die boere ook soms
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Net soos ons het die boere soms
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'ook' repeats what 'net soos ons' already says.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Net soos ons ... ook' is a normal Afrikaans pattern; dropping 'ook' is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Maar party genesers het albei soorte werk gedoen.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Party genesers het egter albei soorte werk gedoen.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: A sentence opening with 'Maar' is spoken style; 'egter' gives the same contrast in written text and keeps 'party'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Opening with 'Maar' is acceptable and plain for Grade 5; 'egter' is more formal without being clearly better.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: By latere gemeenskappe en vandag nog is
laat_vaar_vorige.na: By latere gemeenskappe, en vandag nog, is
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'en vandag nog' is an inserted afterthought between the opening phrase and the verb; enclosing it in commas makes the sentence easier to read.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'By latere gemeenskappe en vandag nog' is one compound adverbial and reads clearly; AWS 2017 puts no comma before 'en' between parts of one sentence.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: weet goed watter plant om te gebruik
laat_vaar_vorige.na: weet goed watter plant hy of sy moet gebruik
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'watter plant om te gebruik' copies the English 'which plant to use'; a full clause with 'moet' is more natural Afrikaans and matches 'Hy of sy' earlier in the block.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'weet watter plant om te gebruik' is accepted, natural Afrikaans (like 'weet wat om te doen'); the clause with 'hy of sy moet' is only longer, a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: watter plante om te soek en hoe om hulle te gebruik
laat_vaar_vorige.na: watter plante hulle moes soek en hoe om dit te gebruik
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'watter plante om te soek' is the same English pattern, and 'hulle' directly after 'jonger mense' can be read as the people rather than the plants; 'dit' refers clearly to the plants.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'watter plante om te soek' is natural Afrikaans and 'hulle' clearly points to the plants just named; the proposal adds the obligation 'moes' and a new 'hulle' for the people, so it is longer and shifts nuance without fixing a real fault.
